test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
'Mission Kushal Karmi' was launched to upgrade the skills of construction workers.

This programme was launched by the government of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Delhi government on 6 July 2022 launched the ‘Mission Kushal Karmi’ programme to upgrade the skills of construction workers.
 
• The programme was launched by Delhi Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia.
 
• The objective of this programme is to provide on-the-job skill development training to construction workers.
 
• Delhi govt aims to train 2 lakh workers in a year under this programme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Delhi government has decided to replace the word 'Harijan' from the names of colonies and streets and rename them after Babasaheb Ambedkar instead.
 
• Delhi, officially the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi, is a city and a union territory of India containing New Delhi, the capital of India.
 
• Delhi:​ 
 
 
• Lt. Governor: Vinai Kumar Saxena
 
• Chief Minister: Arvind Kejriwal 
 
• Deputy Chief Minister: Manish Sisodia
 
• Legislature Unicameral: 70 seats
 
• Parliamentary constituencies: Rajya Sabha (3 seats) Lok Sabha (7 seats)
